OMORI Sandbox

A downloadable game for Windows and Linux

OmoriSandbox is a recreation of the OMORI battle system in the Godot game engine, mainly written in C#. It aims to recreate the battles from OMORI as accurately as possible, while allowing for any combination of party members, enemies, skills, and items, much like a sandbox mode in other games. 

Some notable features include:

  • Completely customizable battles via a visual GUI editor. Change the battle's battleback, BGM, enemies, party members, skills, items, and other aspects of battle to your liking. Or, share your created preset and have others try defeating your creation.
  • 35+ enemies and bosses recreated from scratch.
  • Completely customizable Boss Rush.
  • Re-adds console exclusive content, including a playable Basil, his skills and followups, as well as the Aubrey, Kel, Hero, and Bossman Hero bosses.
  • Built-in QOL inspired by existing OMORI mods, including More Info and State Icons.
  • Completely customizable keybinds and additional settings to further customize your experience.
  • Patches some bugs from the base game to improve gameplay. However, some bugs were intentionally recreated.
  • Supports modding via an official modding API

The project is open source and is available to view on the Github page linked below. You can read more about the project, follow development progress, contribute to the project, or report bugs and issues there.

https://github.com/EBro912/OmoriSandbox

Official Documentation is also available:

https://ebro912.gitbook.io/omorisandbox

You can also join the Discord for further support and to share your presets and mods with others:

https://discord.gg/3sc4waMg2F

As the project uses assets from the base game, the project is and always will be free to download on both Itch.io and GitHub. Any other sources that claim to charge money for OmoriSandbox are scams and should not be trusted.

There are a couple of versions available to download. Make sure to read the Install Instructions section to ensure you download the correct version for your system.

Install instructions

Simply download your system's respective archive and extract the contents to any folder. There are two versions to choose from:

For Windows Users:

Download OmoriSandbox.zip.

The archive should contain two executables:

  • OmoriSandbox.console.exe: Runs the Sandbox alongside a seperate console window. Useful for viewing debug information and any errors that may occur while using the Sandbox. (Recommended)
  • OmoriSandbox.exe: Runs just the Sandbox without a console.

For Linux Users:

Download OmoriSandbox_Linux.zip.

To run the Sandbox, you can either use the provided OmoriSandbox.sh script, or run the OmoriSandbox.x86_64 executable directly.
